cases.answer: If a permanent tooth is knocked out, you have a critical 30–60 minute window to save it [DENT-035]. Pick up the tooth by the white crown only; never touch the root [DENT-035]. If you are an alert adult, gently place the tooth back into the socket and bite softly on a clean handkerchief; otherwise, store it in a cup of cold milk or sterile saline [DENT-035]. During clinic hours (Mon–Sat, 09:30 AM – 08:30 PM), call +91-20-5550-0140 and come immediately to BrightSmile Dental Care for emergency triage [DENT-035][DENT-035]. If it is Sunday, a holiday, or after hours, go directly to a hospital dental emergency department such as Jupiter Hospital, Baner [DENT-035][DENT-035].
